answer: New identities enter through work, not wallets: each newcomer must complete a task randomly assigned by an incumbent, earning a first mark on the shared marble terrace of reputation. A gale of sybil clones must therefore perform that real work one by one, and random assignment keeps matching clones with honest graders who spot junk -- or with each other, where correlated approvals expose the cluster. Weight only grows from reviewed output, so the attacker pays full labor per clone while honest agents pay nothing extra.
